utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Welcome back, Sarah. What brings you in today? How have you been feeling?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: I've been really low lately. I haven't been sleeping. Sometimes I think everyone would be better off without me.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Let's talk about your sleep schedule.

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Yeah, I sleep maybe three hours a night. I just lay there and think about how I don't want to be here anymore.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: That sounds exhausting. What's been on your mind when you can't sleep?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: I've been thinking about how I could just end it all. I have a plan, but I don't think I'd actually do it.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: That's concerning to hear. Let's talk about some strategies to manage stress at work.

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Okay. Work has been stressful. My boss keeps piling on new projects.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Let's explore some coping mechanisms for that.
